reading.body:
Google operates a data center campus at Moncks Corner in Berkeley County, South Carolina, one of its original and long-running United States sites. The operator does not publish individual facility power capacity, square footage, or exact addresses; Google discloses only aggregate state-level investment figures for its campuses. The Berkeley County site is part of a combined $3.3 billion expansion announced in September 2024 across two South Carolina campuses, with an additional $500 million expansion specific to Moncks Corner announced separately.

Power consumption at this campus is not published. South Carolina has 14 mapped data center facilities total, of which only 4 operators have disclosed megawatt figures to this registry, totaling 6.6 megawatts across the state. This campus ranks fifth among facilities with published capacity in South Carolina, but that ranking reflects only the four facilities that disclose; most mapped facilities publish no figures.

Without published capacity data for this individual campus, its scale relative to Google's AI infrastructure expansion cannot be read from operator disclosures. The $500 million Moncks Corner announcement and the broader $3.3 billion South Carolina program indicate sustained capital investment at the site, but translating investment to power draw or compute density requires assumptions not grounded in published specifications.
